xax_query.name: xax_query
xax_query.title: XAX semantic reference query
xax_query.description: Inspect public native CIDs, kinds and reference edges. Empty arguments retain the legacy bounded inventory. Select objects, entity, dependencies, users or a one-hop reference neighborhood; repeat selectors with each root-bound cursor. Pages have at most 64 rows. object_kind filters source objects. The typed selection reads at most 4194304 public inspection bytes and reports inventoryComplete=false if truncated; no continuation beyond that prefix. Edges are generic references, not typed calls, operands, signatures or effect facts.

xax_execute.name: xax_execute
xax_execute.title: XAX execute
xax_execute.description: Preview: builds the current authorized artifact, then executes it in the native Windows AppContainer and one-process job. Optional stdin_hex supplies exact binary stdin followed by EOF; args excludes argv[0]. Returns exit_code, separate stdout_hex/stderr_hex, duration_ms, user_cpu_100ns, kernel_cpu_100ns, peak_memory_bytes and stdin_bytes_supplied. Host-owned limits: 262144 stdin bytes, 64 arguments, 8192 total UTF-16 argument units, 1048576 combined output bytes, 5 s total CPU, 10 s wall, 256 MiB memory. Exhaustion, setup, measurement and cleanup failures return isError. No executable, environment, grant or budget overrides. Typed layouts, registered external tools and Linux execution remain unsupported.

stdin_hex.description: Exact binary stdin as hexadecimal; omitted means empty input. Maximum 262144 decoded bytes.

args.description: Arguments after argv[0]. Empty strings are preserved. Maximum 8192 UTF-16 code units in total; embedded NUL and invalid Unicode are rejected.

xax_result.name: xax_result
xax_result.title: XAX result
xax_result.description: UNIMPLEMENTED natively; calls fail closed with 'unsupported'. Target contract: fetch a bounded chunk of a large result by opaque handle: execution stdout (res_), a workspace's canonical store bytes (ws_), or a stored diagnostic (diag_). Never returns unbounded data.

xax_capabilities.name: xax_capabilities
xax_capabilities.title: XAX capabilities
xax_capabilities.description: Server/compiler identity, pinned XAX revision, targets, operations, carrier types, I/O modes, granted rights, sandbox status and honest maturity labels. Call first.

xax_workspace.name: xax_workspace
xax_workspace.title: XAX workspace
xax_workspace.description: Describe the single host-granted workspace: canonical root, store byte size and first function identity from bounded native inspection. The OS holds an exclusive directory lease until process exit. No open/close or portable scoped handles.

xax_build.name: xax_build
xax_build.title: XAX build
xax_build.description: PROTOTYPE: resolves and builds the current store with the host-granted native XAX compiler ('resolve' then 'build'), writing snapshot/artifact/provenance into the host-granted work directory. Returns the canonical root, artifact byte count and the provenance object (byte count and hex). Artifact handles, entry/package selection, digest reports and toolchain caching are not implemented yet.

xax_transaction.name: xax_transaction
xax_transaction.title: XAX transaction
xax_transaction.description: Apply an exact-root XAXEDIT1 typed mutation carrier. Native edit stages a candidate; native verify must succeed before atomic publication. Rejection or decline retains the current root. Record is hexadecimal transport, not source. Generation/read-set extensions remain unsupported.

xax_construct.name: xax_construct
xax_construct.title: XAX native construction
xax_construct.description: Construct a new supported graph with an exact-root XAXEDIT1 typed mutation carrier. Native XAX applies and verifies the staged candidate before publication. The record is hexadecimal transport; canonical semantic state is source. JSON xax-construct-v1 is unsupported.
